content: Lesol e so꞉wayo꞉ mo꞉sa꞉la꞉lia꞉no꞉ dowabiki, adomo꞉ kulufa꞉ya꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Ya꞉kobo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Giyo꞉ so꞉wayo꞉ nemo꞉wo꞉ mo꞉dimialega, ne soma꞉no꞉.”
Ya꞉kob eyo꞉ Lesolmo꞉wo꞉ gadia꞉sa꞉ga꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Giyo꞉ ne Gode a꞉la꞉asulaya? Godeya꞉ eneno꞉ ge so꞉wayo꞉ mo꞉sa꞉la꞉lima꞉ki faino ga ta꞉fo꞉lab.”

A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki Lesol e sa꞉laki, “Niyo꞉ na꞉ nanog ka꞉isale Bilha a꞉no꞉ gemo꞉ dimia꞉nigo꞉l. So꞉wa elo꞉ sa꞉la꞉liab a꞉no꞉ ne ta꞉uma꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, ge e o꞉lia꞉ alila꞉bi. A꞉la꞉dimidalega eya a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉yo꞉, so꞉wa nilo꞉wo꞉ fa꞉la꞉doma꞉ib.”
A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ Lesol eyo꞉ ene nanog ka꞉isale Bilha a꞉no꞉ Ya꞉koba꞉ inga doma꞉ki ta꞉tabiki, Ya꞉kob e Bilha o꞉lia꞉ alila꞉la꞉ga꞉, so꞉wayo꞉ alelo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ eyo꞉ kalu so꞉wayo꞉ sa꞉la꞉me.

Sa꞉la꞉liabiki Lesol eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Gode eyo꞉ nilo꞉ man dimida꞉sen a꞉no꞉ aloba꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉, eyo꞉ nemo꞉wo꞉ o꞉li dimidabo꞉lo꞉b a꞉la꞉asulo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, nilo꞉ dabu ba꞉ba꞉ a꞉no꞉ da꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉, kalu so꞉wayo꞉ nemo꞉wo꞉ dimiab.” Lesol eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉sa꞉ga꞉, so꞉wa a꞉no꞉ Dan
wikilo꞉.
A꞉ma꞉ fa꞉s amio꞉, Bilhayo꞉ wa꞉ka alela꞉sa꞉ga꞉, kalu so꞉wa nowo꞉ Ya꞉kobo꞉ sa꞉la꞉me.
Sa꞉la꞉liabiki, Lesol eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ne nado o꞉lia꞉ eteyo꞉wo꞉ alan dowa꞉len a꞉no꞉, o꞉go꞉ niyo꞉ tinio꞉l.” A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ so꞉wa a꞉no꞉ Nabtali
wikilo꞉.
Leayo꞉ e so꞉wayo꞉ wa꞉kabiyo꞉ mo꞉sa꞉la꞉lia꞉no꞉ dowabiki, ene nanog ka꞉isale Silba a꞉no꞉ Ya꞉koba꞉ inga doma꞉ki ta꞉fo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, Silba eyo꞉ kalu so꞉wa nowo꞉ Ya꞉kobo꞉ sa꞉la꞉me.
So꞉wa a꞉no꞉ sa꞉la꞉liabikiyo꞉, Lea eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Mada o꞉m, nemo꞉wo꞉ nafale dimidab.” A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ eyo꞉ so꞉wa a꞉no꞉ Gad
wikilo꞉.

A꞉ma꞉ fa꞉s amio꞉, Leaya꞉ ene nanog ka꞉isale Silbayo꞉ kalu so꞉wa nowo꞉ wa꞉ka sa꞉la꞉liabiki, Lea eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ne mada sagalo꞉ alan dowab ko꞉lo꞉, ka꞉isale nolba꞉yo꞉ ‘E sagalo꞉ dowab’ a꞉la꞉sa꞉ma꞉ib.” A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ eyo꞉ so꞉wa a꞉no꞉ Asel
wikilo꞉.
Da꞉si wit folo꞉ tuma꞉no꞉ ho꞉len a꞉no꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowabiki, Lubeno꞉ egelo꞉wa sia꞉likiyo꞉, mendeg hende nolo꞉ walilia꞉sa꞉ga꞉, ano Lea emo꞉wo꞉ dia꞉gane.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Lesol eyo꞉ Leamo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Mendeg hende ko꞉lo꞉ gi so꞉waya꞉lo꞉ dia꞉yab a꞉no꞉ nolo꞉ nelo꞉ mena.”

Ko꞉sega Lea eyo꞉ emo꞉wo꞉ gadi sa꞉lakiyo꞉, “Kalu nilo꞉wo꞉ gi afale dio꞉go꞉le ko꞉sega, man a꞉no꞉ o꞉ngo꞉malo꞉ngo꞉ a꞉la꞉asulakiyo꞉, o꞉go꞉ mendeg hende ni so꞉waya꞉lo꞉ a꞉no꞉lo꞉ gi afale dia꞉nigaya?” A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki Lesol eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Giyo꞉ mendeg hende we nemo꞉wo꞉ dimialega, o꞉g nuluwo꞉ Ya꞉kobo꞉ ge o꞉lia꞉ alima꞉ hamana a꞉la꞉sa꞉ma꞉no꞉,” a꞉la꞉sio꞉.

A꞉la꞉go꞉ko꞉lo꞉ ga꞉lowo꞉ Ya꞉kobo꞉ egelo꞉wa a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ya꞉len ami, Lea eyo꞉ e galilia꞉ga꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “O꞉go꞉ ni so꞉waya꞉lo꞉ mendeg hende dia꞉mio꞉ a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ ge o꞉ma kilili ko꞉lo꞉, o꞉g nuluwo꞉ ge ne o꞉lia꞉ alima꞉no꞉.” A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki o꞉g nulu a꞉namio꞉ Lea o꞉lia꞉ ali.
Lea elo꞉ asulo꞉ a꞉no꞉ Gode eyo꞉ ba꞉ba꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, e so꞉wayo꞉ alela꞉sa꞉ga꞉, kalu so꞉wa biyo꞉ Ya꞉kobo꞉ a꞉na sa꞉la꞉me.
Sa꞉la꞉liakiyo꞉ Lea eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ni nanog ka꞉isaleyo꞉ kalu nilo꞉mo꞉ dimi ko꞉lo꞉, Gode eyo꞉ nemo꞉wo꞉ sagalakiyo꞉, wa꞉lo꞉ dimiab.” A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ eyo꞉ so꞉wa a꞉no꞉ Isaka wikilo꞉.

A꞉ma꞉ fa꞉s amio꞉, Leayo꞉ wa꞉ka alela꞉sa꞉ga꞉, kalu so꞉wa do꞉go꞉feyo꞉ a꞉na Ya꞉kobo꞉ sa꞉la꞉me ko꞉lo꞉ eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Niyo꞉ kalu so꞉wa do꞉go꞉fela꞉fo꞉ we Ya꞉kob emo꞉ sa꞉la꞉me. Gode eyo꞉ boba nafale a꞉no꞉ nemo꞉ dimiabo꞉lo꞉biki, o꞉go꞉ kalu nilo꞉ma꞉yo꞉ ne wabuluma꞉ib.” Eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉sa꞉ga꞉, so꞉wa a꞉no꞉ Sebulun
wikilo꞉.
Tif amio꞉, Lea eyo꞉ ka꞉isale so꞉wa imilig nowo꞉ a꞉na sa꞉la꞉lia꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Daina wikilo꞉.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Gode eyo꞉ Lesolo꞉ wa꞉ka asulabikiyo꞉, elo꞉ dulugu sio꞉ a꞉no꞉ Godeyo꞉ da꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Lesol e so꞉wayo꞉ o꞉li sa꞉la꞉lima꞉ki dimido꞉.
A꞉la꞉dimidabiki Lesol e so꞉wayo꞉ alelo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, kalu so꞉wayo꞉ a꞉na sa꞉la꞉lia꞉sa꞉ga꞉, eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ne ko꞉lo꞉ sendelowa꞉sen a꞉no꞉ Gode eyo꞉ dila꞉” a꞉la꞉sio꞉.
Lesol eyo꞉ to nowo꞉ a꞉sa꞉lakiyo꞉, “Yawe eyo꞉ kalu so꞉wa nowo꞉ nemo꞉wo꞉ wa꞉ka a꞉dimina꞉ki asulo꞉l.” A꞉la꞉sio꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ so꞉wa a꞉no꞉ Yosa꞉b
wikilo꞉.
Ya꞉koba꞉ sibi bo꞉fo꞉len a꞉no꞉ modo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉
Lesol eyo꞉ Yosa꞉bo꞉ sa꞉la꞉lia꞉sa꞉ga꞉ dowabikiyo꞉, Ya꞉kob eyo꞉ Labanbo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ne o꞉go꞉ no꞉no꞉n hena ha꞉na꞉no꞉ asulab ko꞉lo꞉ giyo꞉ ne iliga꞉foma.
Niyo꞉ ga o꞉lia꞉ so꞉wa o꞉lia꞉ kililiakiyo꞉, nanog gilo꞉wo꞉ halaido꞉ dimida꞉len. Nanog a꞉no꞉ tambo ditandale ko꞉lo꞉, o꞉go꞉ giyo꞉ ni ga o꞉lia꞉ so꞉wa o꞉lia꞉ a꞉no꞉ nemo꞉ tililia꞉ hamana꞉ki ta꞉foma.”

A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki Laban eyo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉bo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Tamin amio꞉ niyo꞉ to nowo꞉ gemo꞉ ko꞉le sa꞉ma꞉nigo꞉l. Niyo꞉ fofa dimidan mamamo꞉wo꞉ dabu ba꞉ba꞉ amio꞉, iliyo꞉ fanda asuluma꞉no꞉ we nemo꞉ wido꞉. Ge ne o꞉lia꞉lo꞉ dofo꞉len a꞉na ilikiyo꞉, niyo꞉ Yawe eyo꞉ ne nafale mesea꞉ki ta꞉fo꞉labo꞉lo꞉b a꞉la꞉bo꞉ ele ba꞉ba꞉.
A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ ge wenaka o꞉salega, nanog gilo꞉ diab amilo꞉ kililia꞉no꞉ a꞉no꞉, kelego꞉ gilo꞉ asulakilo꞉ sa꞉lab aumbo꞉, niyo꞉ gemo꞉wo꞉ o꞉li dimia꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉lab.”
A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, Ya꞉kob eyo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉bo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ne dona modo꞉wo꞉ gi nanogo꞉ nafale dia꞉len a꞉la꞉bo꞉ ge asulab. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ no꞉ fofo꞉ gilo꞉wo꞉ niyo꞉ dinafa bo꞉fo꞉len ko꞉lo꞉ nafale fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉.

Ne wilo꞉ o꞉semo꞉ mio꞉ amio꞉, ge kelego꞉ a꞉la꞉se ko꞉lo꞉ elen, ko꞉sega nilo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉len amio꞉ kelego꞉ gilo꞉ a꞉no꞉ modo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ analifa꞉. Niyo꞉ nanogdo꞉ dia꞉len amio꞉ Yawe eyo꞉ ne asuwa꞉takiyo꞉, ge nafale mesea꞉ki ta꞉fo꞉lab. Ko꞉sega so꞉lo꞉ nilo꞉ we abe asuwa꞉fa꞉iba? O꞉go꞉ no꞉no꞉n so꞉lo꞉wo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ tilidoma꞉no꞉ asulab.”

A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki Laban eyo꞉ emo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉dabu ba꞉ba꞉, “Ge wenamio꞉ o꞉mesa꞉nikiyo꞉, niyo꞉ gemo꞉wo꞉ kelego꞉ o꞉b ko꞉lo꞉ dimina꞉ki asulaya?” Ya꞉kobo꞉ to a꞉no꞉ da꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉, a꞉ma꞉la꞉ sa꞉laki, “A, giyo꞉ kelego꞉wo꞉ nemo꞉wo꞉ dimia꞉so꞉bo. Ko꞉sega giyo꞉ nemo꞉wo꞉ to nowo꞉ dinali sa꞉lalega, gi no꞉ fofan a꞉no꞉ niyo꞉ wa꞉ka a꞉bo꞉fo꞉mela꞉no꞉.

O꞉go꞉ ne ha꞉na꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, sibi o꞉lia꞉ goudi o꞉lia꞉ gilo꞉ a꞉no꞉ ni aloba꞉daki, sibi o꞉lia꞉ goudi o꞉lia꞉ momado꞉le a꞉no꞉, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ sibi inso꞉ henela꞉ a꞉no꞉lo꞉ aloba꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉, ni nanog diab amilo꞉ kililian aumbo꞉, a꞉no꞉ tambo ne dia꞉no꞉ asulo꞉l.

Niyo꞉ digale dimido꞉wa꞉le a꞉la꞉likiyo꞉, giyo꞉ tif amio꞉ bebema꞉ yakiyo꞉, goudi mo꞉momado꞉ nowo꞉ a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ sibi inso꞉ mo꞉henela꞉ nowo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ no꞉ nilo꞉ usamio꞉ ba꞉dalega, giyo꞉ ni afale dilo꞉b a꞉la꞉asuluma꞉ib.”
Ya꞉kob elo꞉ to sa꞉lab a꞉no꞉ da꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Laban eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “O꞉li ko꞉m. Gilo꞉ sa꞉lab au dimidama꞉niki.”

Ko꞉sega o꞉g a꞉namio꞉ Laban e ha꞉na꞉ga꞉, goudi mala o꞉lia꞉ de o꞉lia꞉ momadela꞉le a꞉no꞉ a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ sibi inso꞉ henela꞉ a꞉no꞉lo꞉ tambo aloba꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Laban o꞉lia꞉ ene inso꞉ o꞉lia꞉ma꞉yo꞉ no꞉ a꞉no꞉ tililia꞉ ha꞉nakiyo꞉, ho꞉len otalen alita꞉ga꞉, ene so꞉wamo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉melea꞉ki a꞉na ta꞉fo꞉. A꞉la꞉dimida꞉labikiyo꞉, Ya꞉kob e amisa꞉n a꞉naka siliki, Labana꞉ no꞉ fofo꞉ nolo꞉ e bo꞉fo꞉len.
Ya꞉kob eyo꞉ no꞉ nolo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉likiyo꞉, i ko꞉li ko꞉lilo꞉ a꞉ma꞉ ele nolo꞉ gedea꞉sa꞉ga꞉, i ele a꞉namio꞉ ho꞉lo꞉ fa꞉la꞉doma꞉kiyo꞉, do꞉go꞉f nolo꞉ sili alifela꞉sa꞉ga꞉ dila꞉.

Eyo꞉ i ele momado꞉ a꞉no꞉ no꞉wa꞉lo꞉ ho꞉ndo꞉ na꞉sen i solo꞉ us a꞉na difa꞉. A꞉la꞉do꞉ dimido꞉ a꞉ma꞉yo꞉, no꞉wa꞉yo꞉ ho꞉no꞉ ma꞉ni yakiyo꞉, i ele momado꞉ a꞉no꞉ ili milifa doma꞉ki go꞉. Mo꞉wo꞉ no꞉wo꞉ ho꞉n ma꞉ni yakiyo꞉, iyo꞉ a꞉na ga꞉gila꞉sen.
A꞉la꞉dimidalifa꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ no꞉wo꞉ i ele momado꞉ a꞉no꞉ bo꞉fo꞉liki ga꞉la꞉lab ko꞉lo꞉, inso꞉wo꞉ tambo momado꞉le segesela꞉i ane.

Ya꞉kob eyo꞉ sibi inso꞉ momadela꞉ a꞉no꞉ aloba꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉, egelese mesea꞉ki ta꞉fo꞉. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ no꞉ malalo꞉ ga꞉lab ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉, Ya꞉kob eyo꞉ no꞉ malayo꞉ no꞉ momado꞉ a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉liki ga꞉la꞉melea꞉ki ta꞉fo꞉. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ eyo꞉ no꞉ momado꞉le silia꞉ta꞉len a꞉no꞉ alobanalia꞉ ta꞉felo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, Labana꞉ no꞉ o꞉lia꞉ Ya꞉koba꞉ ene no꞉ a꞉no꞉lia꞉yo꞉ mo꞉gasa dowo꞉.

No꞉ mala halaido꞉ a꞉no꞉ ga꞉lima꞉no꞉ ho꞉len dowab amio꞉, Ya꞉kob eyo꞉ i ele momado꞉ a꞉no꞉ no꞉wa꞉lo꞉ ho꞉ndo꞉ na꞉sen i solo꞉ us a꞉na dia꞉ta꞉sen. A꞉la꞉dimido꞉ a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ no꞉ malaya꞉lo꞉ ga꞉la꞉lab amio꞉, i ele a꞉no꞉ ini milifa doma꞉ki go꞉.

Ko꞉sega no꞉ mala halaido꞉lo꞉ma a꞉no꞉ ga꞉lima꞉no꞉ ho꞉len dowab amio꞉, i ele a꞉no꞉ mo꞉dia꞉ta꞉sen. A꞉la꞉go꞉ko꞉lo꞉ no꞉ inso꞉ halaido꞉lo꞉ma dowab a꞉no꞉ Laban eno꞉ ta꞉taki, no꞉ inso꞉ halaido꞉lo꞉ dowab a꞉no꞉ Ya꞉kob e di.
A꞉la꞉dimida꞉labikiyo꞉, Ya꞉kob e wilo꞉ kalu mada alan fa꞉la꞉dowakiyo꞉, no꞉ fofo꞉ enedo꞉ a꞉no꞉lo꞉, nanog dian kaluka꞉isaleyo꞉lo꞉, donkiyo꞉lo꞉, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ka꞉mol o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ modo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉.

footnotes.text: 30.6 Dana꞉ wi a꞉no꞉, “alobo꞉no꞉” a꞉la꞉do꞉ sa꞉lan o꞉leo꞉ngo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉lab.
30.8 Nabtaliya꞉ wi a꞉no꞉ “eteyo꞉” a꞉la꞉do꞉ sa꞉lan o꞉leo꞉ngo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉lab.
30.11 Gada꞉ wi a꞉no꞉, “mada o꞉m” a꞉la꞉do꞉ sa꞉lan o꞉leo꞉ngo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉lab.
30.12-13 Asela꞉ wi a꞉no꞉, “sagalo꞉” a꞉la꞉do꞉ sa꞉lan o꞉leo꞉ngo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉lab.

30.14 O꞉g ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉, kaluka꞉isale iliyo꞉ a꞉la꞉tili asulo꞉. Ka꞉isale abeyo꞉ mendeg hende a꞉no꞉ nalega, so꞉wayo꞉ alelema꞉ib a꞉la꞉asulo꞉. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ kalu abeyo꞉ nalega, ga o꞉lia꞉lo꞉ alima꞉no꞉wo꞉ alan asuluma꞉ib.
30.18 Isakaya꞉ wi a꞉no꞉, “wa꞉lo꞉ dimidab” a꞉la꞉do꞉ sa꞉lan o꞉leo꞉ngo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉lab.
30.19-20 Sebuluna꞉ wi a꞉no꞉, “wabudan” a꞉la꞉do꞉ sa꞉lan o꞉leo꞉ngo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉lab.
30.24 Yosa꞉ba꞉ wi a꞉no꞉, “nemo꞉ wa꞉ka a꞉dimia꞉bi” a꞉la꞉do꞉ sa꞉lan o꞉leo꞉ngo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉lab.
